dialogues.speaker: Wolfy
dialogues.text: You guys like to read storybooks? Me too!

dialogues.speaker: Wolfy
dialogues.text: I like to imagine I'm a character in the book when I read. Sometimes I'm Wolfy the Brave, others Wolfy the Wise... and sometimes, I'm even the Big Bad Wolfy!

dialogues.speaker: Wolfy
dialogues.text: "Awoooo! Foolish Traveler! You dare enter this fortress of doom without invitation! Prepare to be eaten alive!"

dialogues.speaker: Wolfy
dialogues.text: What do you think? Totally got that "Big Bad Wolf" energy, right?

dialogues.speaker: Wolfy
dialogues.text: ...These stories are like those dreams, they're all shining memories, treasures that belong only to me. They are also a weapon that makes me invincible, no matter what situation I may face.
